BiblicalUsage: ʻÊth Qâtsîyn was a town on the border of Zebulun. The name occurs once, in Joshua. There is no People profile for it, because it is a place, not a person.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that ʻÊth Qâtsîyn is there on purpose, like every name in Scripture. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
